grammar.title: Looks like with 看起来/看上去
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 看起来/看上去 + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 看起来 (kàn qǐlái) and 看上去 (kàn shàngqù) both mean "it looks like, it seems" — describing an impression based on appearance. They go right before an adjective, and are used interchangeably.

sentences.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái bǐ yǐqián niánqīng.
